title: Sobha Townpark
subtitle: New York - Themed Luxury Apartments
description: Welcome to the newest phase of SOBHA Townpark - Bengaluru’s one and only New York-themed township. Located on Hosur Road near Electronic City, these modern homes are surrounded by world-class amenities for all age groups. Live in a vibrant, stylish community that brings the energy of NYC right to your doorstep. It’s a lifestyle like no other - exciting, exclusive, and full of life, every single day.

title: Sobha Neopolis
subtitle: Greek-Themed Luxury Apartments
description: Step into SOBHA Neopolis, a stunning Greek-themed township near Panathur, just off Marathahalli – ORR. Inspired by timeless Grecian architecture, these luxury homes are designed for all age groups and offer everything you need for a modern lifestyle. With world-class amenities and beautiful surroundings, living here feels like a Mediterranean holiday every day.

title: Sobha Infinia
subtitle: Ultra-luxe Abodes
description: Step into SOBHA Infinia, where stunning architecture and modern style come together. These iconic apartments are thoughtfully designed with a clean, minimalist look that feels both elegant and smart. Every detail reflects contemporary living at its finest – stylish, comfortable, and truly sophisticated.

title: Sobha Galera
subtitle: Timeless Spanish Homes
description: Inspired by the scenic town of Galera and classic Spanish architecture, SOBHA Galera offers a unique and luxurious lifestyle. These peaceful row houses are set in a quiet yet well-connected location, designed for those who appreciate privacy and elegance. Live in a beautifully crafted home made for the select few who want something truly special.

title: Sobha Ayana
subtitle: Modern Tropical Apartments
description: Welcome to SOBHA Ayana, where city life meets the calm of nature. Spread across 81 acres within SOBHA Dream Acres, this beautiful community offers modern homes surrounded by greenery and peace. With over 100 top-class amenities, contemporary design, and lush open spaces, SOBHA Ayana is perfect for those who want a calm, nature-filled lifestyle without leaving the city behind.

title: Sobha Crystal Meadows
subtitle: Grand Quadruplex Row Houses
description: Experience a life of luxury at SOBHA Crystal Meadows, Bengaluru's first Millionaires' Row. These grand villas feature elegant Victorian architecture, beautiful stone exteriors, large glass windows, spacious terraces, and private gardens. Every home is designed for comfort, style, and exclusivity. Join a community of high achievers and enjoy a lifestyle that's truly one of a kind.
